Identify gene clusters

identify_gene_clusters.Rd

Identifies genomic clusters of differentially expressed genes.

Differentially expressed genes are mapped to their genomic coordinates and grouped into clusters based on genomic proximity. Genes separated by less than gapwidth base pairs are assigned to the same cluster.

Usage

identify_gene_clusters(
  de_results,
  p_adj_cutoff = 0.01,
  logfc_cutoff = 0,
  gapwidth = 2e+06
)

Arguments

de_results

Differential expression results returned by compare_spatial_clusters()

p_adj_cutoff

Adjusted p-value threshold

logfc_cutoff

Minimum log2 fold-change used to define differentially expressed genes

gapwidth

Maximum genomic distance between genes for inclusion in the same cluster

Value

A list containing cluster assignments for differentially expressed genes (cluster_assignments) and the corresponding genomic ranges (gr_de).
